blocks.text:
The Belize Barrier Reef, jungle and Maya heritage come together in one journey. At Lamanai, choose from the lodge’s nature and cultural activities; in Cayo, visit Xunantunich; cross into Guatemala for a day at Tikal; then end your trip by the sea in San Pedro. For more time on the water, Ambergris Caye offers snorkelling at Hol Chan and Shark Ray Alley, Mexico Rocks and Coral Gardens, as well as sunset cruises.

## Hotels and prices

Accommodation: 2 nights at Lamanai Outpost Lodge, 2 nights at Cahal Pech Village and 3 nights at Sunbreeze Hotel. Meals and taxes as specified in the programme.

| Accommodation | Price per person |
|---|---:|
| SGL, 1 guest | $6,292 |
| DBL, 2 guests | $3,853 |
| TPL, 3 guests | $3,136 |
